## Homework in WileyPLUS

All homework will be assigned, completed **individually**, and automatically
graded through WileyPLUS. WileyPLUS access is therefore a
[required course resource](resources.qmd#wileyplus).

- Launch every WileyPLUS homework assignment from Canvas. Do not search for or
  join the course separately on the WileyPLUS website.
- Homework scores are passed automatically from WileyPLUS to the Canvas
  gradebook.
- Unless a homework assignment states otherwise, it is due by **11:59 PM
  Chicago Time** on the due date. Canvas displays due dates in your time zone.

## Other assignments

- Unless otherwise stated, you may work on non-homework file-upload assignments
  **individually** or in **pairs**, and your choice may change from one
  assignment to the next.
- For each assignment that permits pairs, I will create a **group set in
  Canvas**; you will sign up to form your group.
- **Only one person per pair submits** a group assignment in Canvas. The
  submission, grade, and feedback are automatically shared with both group
  members.
- Unless an assignment states otherwise, it is due by **11:59 PM Chicago
  Time** on the due date. Canvas displays due dates in your time zone.
- Each file-upload submission must include **all relevant files**:

  1. A self-contained, working copy of any code used.
  2. A PDF version of item 1, including the output, plus any analytical work.
     Legible handwriting and typed work are both acceptable. You may embed
     analytical work as Markdown in the code.
